correctness.rationale: On the smooth degree-eight normalized model the Cartier/Hasse–Witt matrix is computed coefficientwise from f(x), splitting into b and a 2×2 block with determinant ac−1. Frobenius-stable block rank is determined by a+c³; when ac=1 its zero locus is a⁴+1=0. A squarefreeness argument excludes simultaneous b=0 and ac=1, and proves the additional forbidden graph b=a²+c² on ac=1. The squarefree generating function Lχ(T)/Lχ²(T²) and character orthogonality prove the total count; inclusion–exclusion of disjoint divisors proves each N_f for every q=3^n. The standalone stdlib verifier exhaustively tests GF(3), GF(9), GF(27), and its actual recorded output matches; finite tests supplement, not replace, the infinite proof. All hypotheses and scope boundaries are explicit.

value.rationale: The extra-involution locus in genus-three hyperelliptic moduli is a classical natural family. Whether its smooth points can have 3-rank zero, how the nonordinary divisor decomposes, and how frequently each 3-rank occurs over all finite extensions are natural structural/arithmetic questions. The proof gives a complete geometric rank-one locus (four G_m components) and exact nontrivial all-extension formulas, not merely a renamed a-number bound, isolated numerical table or routine substitution. Its scope is marked equations and not claimed broader.
